And now, to hear the Gospel preached in bird language, well, maybe that’s what the birds are doing when they’re singing like that: preaching the Gospel to us. You never heard of one having high blood pressure, did you? Did you ever see them on crutches, going to the hospital to be operated on? No, they got a heavenly Father, He watches over them, and He takes care of them.
